blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Water treatment research is expanding rapidly, but much of the knowledge acquired from this research remains scattered across unstructured literature. The field still lacks a dedicated language model that can efficiently capture water treatment-specific domain semantics for large-scale literature mining. Here, we address this by developing WaterBERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), a domain-adapted encoder model designed for semantic representation and structured information extraction from water treatment texts. WaterBERT was developed by continual pretraining on a large-scale water treatment corpus comprising about 2.97 billion tokens. Three fine-tuned models based on WaterBERT were systematically evaluated on downstream tasks, achieving the best overall performance among general-purpose and domain-specific BERT models, with F1 scores of 90.12% for multiclass treatment process classification, 79.50% for named entity recognition, and 74.04% for relation extraction. Beyond these benchmark tasks, we further demonstrated WaterBERT’s advantages for large-scale literature processing. Applied to 5,144 Environmental Science & Technology articles, WaterBERT–BERTopic identified coherent, diverse, and domain-specific research topics without predefined categories. Building on WaterBERT, we processed 693,211 abstracts at substantially lower cost than commercial LLMs while retaining competitive extraction performance to construct a structured water treatment knowledge graph. The knowledge graph was then integrated with lexical and dense retrieval to develop a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS), which achieved a relevance score of 77.7, substantially outperforming text-based retrieval baselines (54.7–64.5). Through WaterBERT, this study provides a compact and scalable semantic foundation for large-scale information processing and evidence mapping in water treatment research.
blocks.zh: 水处理研究正在迅速扩展,但从这一研究中获得的大部分知识仍然分散在无结构的文献中. 该领域仍然缺乏专门的语言模型,能够高效地捕捉水处理特有的域语义,用于大规模文献开采. 在这里,我们通过开发WaterBERT(变形器的双向编码器表示)来解决这个问题,这是一种适合域的编码器模型,用于语义表示和从水处理文本中结构化的信息提取. 通过持续预先培训,开发了由约29.7亿令牌组成的大型水处理装置。 基于WaterBERT的3个微调模型在下游任务上得到了系统评价,在通用和域特定BERT模型中实现了最佳的整体性能,F1分数为多级处理流程分类90.12%,命名实体识别79.50%,关系提取74.04%. 除了这些基准任务之外,我们还进一步展示了WaterBERT在大规模文献处理方面的优势. 适用于5,144篇环境科学与技术文章,WaterBert-BERTOPIC确定了一致、多样化和特定领域的研究专题,但没有预先界定的类别。 在WaterBERT的基础上,我们以比商业有限责任公司低得多的成本处理了693,211份摘要,同时保留了竞争性开采性能,以构建结构化水处理知识图。 知识图随后与词汇学和密集检索相结合,开发了水知识强化检索系统(WaterKERS),其相关分数为77.7,大大超过文本检索基线(54.7-64.5)。 通过WaterBERT,本研究为水处理研究中的大规模信息处理和证据绘图提供了一个紧凑和可伸缩的语义基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Driven by increasingly strict discharge requirements, emerging contaminants, resource recovery objectives and broader sustainability goals, water and wastewater treatment has developed into a rapidly expanding interdisciplinary field, generating a large and diverse body of technical literature. [ 1 , 2 ] By 2026, a Web of Science search for articles associated with wastewater and water treatment yielded more than two million records, including more than 700,000 in the Web of Science Core Collection. These publications contain extensive information on treatment processes, pollutant characteristics, material properties, operating conditions, and treatment performance. Systematically extracting and organizing this information could support the ongoing development and better management of water treatment systems. Potential applications include building training datasets for treatment performance models, creating structured evidence bases for evaluating treatment technologies, and developing domain knowledge graphs to support decision-making in water/wastewater treatment plants. [ 3 , 4 ] However, much of this information remains dispersed across a vast and largely unstructured body of literature, making systematic extraction difficult.
blocks.zh: 在越来越严格的排放要求、新兴污染物、资源回收目标和更广泛的可持续性目标的推动下,水和废水处理已发展成为一个迅速扩展的跨学科领域,产生了大量多样的技术文献。 [1,2]到2026年,一个科学网搜索与废水和水处理有关的文章,获得了200多万份记录,其中包括科学核心集的网络中超过70万份. 这些出版物载有关于处理工艺、污染物特性、材料特性、操作条件和处理性能的广泛信息。 系统地提取和组织这些信息可以支持水处理系统的持续发展和更好的管理。 可能的应用包括建立处理性能模型的培训数据集,为评价处理技术建立结构化的证据基础,以及开发域知识图以支持水/废水处理厂的决策。 [3, 4] 然而,这种信息大部分仍然分散在庞大且基本没有结构的文献中,使得系统提取变得困难.

blocks.en: Natural language processing (NLP) offers a pathway to transform unstructured scientific text into structured knowledge, but effective information extraction from water treatment literature requires domain-specific semantic interpretation rather than general text understanding alone. [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] What a term means depends on its role in and/or relevance to the water treatment system. The same chemical may function as a target pollutant, dosed reagent, catalyst, electrolyte, nutrient source, or background matrix. For example, NaCl may be the target pollutant in studies on saline wastewater treatment or desalination, but it may also serve as an electrolyte or background matrix component in electrochemical treatment systems. [ 8 , 9 ] Likewise, a reported removal efficiency becomes meaningful only when it is linked to the correct treatment process, target contaminant, and operating conditions, because removal may result from adsorption, degradation, membrane rejection, or biological transformation. [ 10 ]
blocks.zh: 自然语言处理(NLP)提供了将无结构的科学文本转化为结构化知识的途径,但从水处理文献中有效提取信息需要域特定的语义解释,而不只是一般的文本理解. [5、6、7] 术语的含义取决于其在水处理系统中的作用和/或与水处理系统的相关性。 同一化学品可作为目标污染物、剂量试剂、催化剂、电解质、营养来源或背景基质发挥作用。 例如,NaCl可能是盐碱废水处理或海水淡化研究中的目标污染物,但它也可能是电化学处理系统中的电解质或背景基质成分. [8,9] 同样,所报告的清除效率只有在与正确的处理过程、目标污染物和操作条件相联系时才有意义,因为清除可能是由于吸附、降解、膜排斥或生物转化。 [10]

blocks.en: When used as standalone models with only simple prompting, general-purpose large language models (LLMs) are likely to perform inconsistently on specialised literature-extraction tasks in water treatment. [ 6 , 11 ] More elaborate strategies, including prompt engineering, agent-based workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), can improve extraction performance in water-related applications. [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] However, these methods often incur substantial costs. For example, Jiang et al. [ 13 ] reported that a structured-prompting pipeline cost approximately CNY 3,000 (~USD 417) to process 5,100 papers. Extrapolating this rate to a field-wide corpus of more than 700,000 water treatment documents would result in a total cost exceeding USD 57,000. Such costs may limit the feasibility of processing literature at this scale. Moreover, previous studies found that adapting open-source LLMs via domain-specific fine-tuning for water-treatment-related tasks offered only limited gains and even underperformed strong commercial models. [ 6 , 15 ] Therefore, more efficient models that can be adapted to the water treatment domain and deployed for corpus-scale information extraction and organisation are needed.
blocks.zh: 当作为仅有简单提示的单独模型使用时,通用大语言模型(LLMs)在水处理方面的专门文献-提取任务可能执行不连贯. [6, 11] 更详尽的战略,包括即时工程、基于代理的工作流程和检索增强生成(RAG),可以改善与水有关的应用中的提取性能。 [12, 13, 14] 然而,这些方法往往需要大量费用。 例如,蒋等人. [13] 报告说,处理5,100份文件的结构化催化管道费用约为3,000CNY(~417美元)。 将这一费率推算为外地70多万份水处理文件,总费用将超过57 000美元。 这种费用可能限制以这种规模处理文献的可行性。 此外,以往的研究发现,通过特定域的精细调整来调整开放源代码的LLMs,以完成与水处理有关的任务,只能取得有限的收益,甚至不能很好地发挥强大的商业模式的作用。 [6, 15] 因此,需要更有效的模式,这些模式可以适应水处理领域,并部署用于实体规模的信息提取和组织。

blocks.en: Among NLP approaches, encoder models from the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) family are well suited to this setting. [ 16 ] Although LLMs are powerful for generation and synthesis, corpus-scale information extraction relies mainly on discriminative tasks such as document screening, named entity recognition, relation extraction, and semantic embedding for topic modelling. Continued Domain-Adaptive Pretraining (DAPT) enables BERT models to learn specialised terminology and usage while retaining general scientific knowledge. [ 7 ] Previous studies have shown that domain-adapted BERT models can outperform general-purpose LLMs on tasks requiring specialised semantic understanding. [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] These models also support efficient and reproducible processing of large document collections and have been applied to large-scale literature analysis in biomedicine, [ 20 ] materials science, [ 21 ] and climate change. [ 22 , 23 ] For example, Zhang et al. [ 20 ] employed a PubMedBERT-based information extraction pipeline to process more than 34 million PubMed abstracts, constructing a large-scale knowledge graph comprising 10,686,927 unique entities and 30,758,640 unique relations. Shetty et al. [ 21 ] further showed that MaterialsBERT, trained on 2.4 million materials science abstracts, enabled the automatic extraction of approximately 300,000 material–property records from around 130,000 polymer abstracts. However, no comparable domain-adapted model has been developed for the specialised terminology and relational semantics of the water treatment literature.
blocks.zh: 在NLP方法中,来自变形器(BERT)家族的双向编码器表示器模型非常适合这种设置. [16] 虽然LLMS对生成和合成具有强大的作用,但实体尺度信息提取主要依赖于诸如文件筛选,命名实体识别,关系提取,以及主题建模的语义嵌入等歧视性任务. 持续的域外预训(DAPT)使BERT模型能够学习专门术语和使用,同时保留一般科学知识. [ 7)以往的研究表明,在需要专门语义理解的任务上,经域调整的BERT模型可以超过通用的LLMs. [17,18,19] 这些模型还支持对大型文件集进行高效和可复制的处理,并已应用于生物医学、[20]材料科学、[21]和气候变化方面的大规模文献分析。 张等. [20] 使用基于PubMedBERT的信息提取管道处理超过3400万PubMed摘要,构建了由10,686,927个独特实体和30,758,640个独特关系组成的大规模知识图. 谢蒂等人. [21] 进一步表明,经过240万份材料科学摘要培训的MonterialBERT能够自动从大约130 000份聚合物摘要中提取大约30万份材料财产记录。 然而,还没有为水处理文献的专门术语和关系语义开发出可比较的适合域的模型。

blocks.en: Here, we develop and apply WaterBERT, the first domain-adapted encoder model for semantic representation and information extraction in water/wastewater treatment research. WaterBERT was developed through continual pretraining of SciBERT on a large-scale water treatment corpus comprising approximately 2.23 billion words. We evaluated WaterBERT across three downstream tasks, including text classification, named entity recognition (NER), and relation extraction (RE). We then applied WaterBERT to large-scale water treatment literature for two corpus-level analyses: topic modelling and structured knowledge graph extraction. The resulting knowledge graph was further integrated into a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS) and evaluated for its ability to enhance literature retrieval. By combining domain-adapted semantic representation with corpus-scale literature analysis, this work provides a practical platform for organizing, retrieving, and mapping evidence across the rapidly expanding water treatment literature.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们开发并应用了WaterBERT,这是水/废水处理研究中第一个经过域调整的语义表达和信息提取编码器模型. 通过对SciBERT持续进行关于大型水处理装置的预训,开发了水处理器,该装置约有22.3亿字。 我们评价了WaterBERT在下游的三个任务,包括文本分类、命名实体识别(NER)和关系提取(RE). 然后,我们把WaterBERT应用于大规模水处理文献中,用于两个实体层面的分析:主题建模和结构化的知识图提取。 由此产生的知识图被进一步纳入水知识强化检索系统(WaterKERS),并对其加强文献检索的能力进行评估。 这项工作将适应域的语义表述与实体尺度的文献分析相结合,为组织、检索和绘制迅速扩展的水处理文献的证据提供了一个实用的平台。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overall workflow
blocks.zh: 2.1 总的工作流程

blocks.en: The overall workflow of this study is shown in Fig. 1 . To develop a language model adapted to water treatment text, we first constructed a large-scale water treatment corpus from scientific literature. We then performed domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) on this corpus using the masked language modeling objective (MLM), in which masked tokens are predicted from their surrounding context, to obtain WaterBERT. After pretraining, WaterBERT was fine-tuned on annotated datasets for three downstream tasks: text classification, named entity recognition (NER), and relation extraction (RE). These tasks were used to evaluate whether WaterBERT can support both document-level literature screening and the extraction of wastewater treatment information. Finally, we examined the potential of WaterBERT for large-scale applications through two case studies: BERTopic-based topic modelling using WaterBERT embeddings and knowledge graph construction using the fine-tuned NER and RE models. Building on the resulting knowledge graph, we further developed a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS) and evaluated its ability to improve literature retrieval.
blocks.zh: 本研究的总体工作流程见图1。 为了开发一个适应水处理文本的语言模型,我们首先从科学文献中构建了一个大规模的水处理装置. 然后,我们利用蒙面语言建模目标(MLM),进行域适应性预训(DAPT),从周围环境预测蒙面标志,以获得WaterBERT。 经过预训,WaterBERT在附加说明的数据集上进行了微调,用于三个下游任务:文本分类,命名实体识别(NER)和关系提取(RE). 这些任务被用来评估WaterBERT是否能够支持文件级文献筛选和废水处理信息的提取. 最后,我们通过两个案例研究审查了WaterBERT大规模应用的潜力:使用WaterBERT嵌入的基于BERT的专题建模和使用微调NER和RE模型的知识图构建. 在由此产生的知识图的基础上,我们进一步发展了水知识强化检索系统(WaterKERS),并评估了该系统改进文献检索的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall workflow of WaterBERT. A domain-specific corpus was constructed from water treatment literature and used for masked language model pretraining. WaterBERT was then fine-tuned for text classification, named entity recognition, and relation extraction, and applied to large-scale literature for topic analysis and structured knowledge graph construction.
blocks.zh: 图1:WaterBERT的总体工作流程. 从水处理文献中构建了一个专有域表,用于蒙面语言模型预训。 随后WaterBERT进行了文字分类,命名实体识别,以及关系提取的微调,并应用于大型文献,用于专题分析和结构化的知识图构建.

blocks.en: 2.2 Corpus construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 公司建筑

blocks.en: A domain-specific corpus is essential for DAPT. We therefore constructed a dedicated corpus covering 693,211 water treatment publications as the pretraining foundation for WaterBERT. We searched the Web of Science Core Collection using the topics “wastewater treatment” and “water treatment”, retrieving 693,211 article abstracts. The corpus included publications available up to February 2026. Among these publications, full texts were additionally available for 296,592 articles from Elsevier and were incorporated into the pretraining corpus. Table S1 presents the high-frequency terms in the resulting corpus. The five most frequent terms were “water”, “treatment”, “surface”, “removal”, and “concentration”, indicating that the corpus was centered on water treatment related research. The raw texts were then deduplicated and filtered to retain only English content. The cleaned texts were segmented into chunks of up to 512 tokens, consistent with the maximum input length of BERT. The final corpus contained approximately 2.23 billion words (2.97 billion tokens) and was split into training and validation sets at a 90:10 ratio for masked language modelling (MLM) pretraining. This broad coverage of water treatment terminology enabled WaterBERT to learn domain-specific language patterns during continual pretraining.
blocks.zh: 专有域表对DAPT至关重要。 因此,我们建造了一个专门水库,包括693 211份水处理出版物,作为WaterBERT的培训基础。 我们利用“废水处理”和“水处理”这两个专题搜索了科学核心集网,检索了693,211条摘要。 调查包括截至2026年2月的出版物。 在这些出版物中,Elsevier还提供了296 592篇文章的全文,并纳入了预训书。 表S1列示了结果中的高频值。 五个最常用的术语是“水”、“处理”、“表面”、“迁移”和“集中”,表明该体以水处理有关的研究为中心。 原始文本随后被复制和过滤,只保留英文内容。 清理后的文本被分割成最多512个令牌的块,与BERT的最大输入长度一致. 最终书目包含约22.3亿字(29.7亿令牌),并被分为培训和验证集,以90:10的比例进行蒙面语言建模(MLM)预训. 水处理术语的这种广泛涵盖范围使得WaterBERT能够在连续的预训期间学习特定领域语言模式。

blocks.en: 2.3 Domain-adaptive pretraining of WaterBERT
blocks.zh: 2.3 水生生物圈域适应性预训

blocks.en: In this study, WaterBERT was developed through DAPT rather than pretraining a new model from scratch. Compared with pretraining from scratch, DAPT adapts a base language model using unlabeled domain-specific text, improving domain-specific semantic representations while preserving general linguistic knowledge in a more computationally efficient manner. [ 7 ] Accordingly, we selected SciBERT as the base model for DAPT, because its scientific pretraining background is more consistent with water treatment literature than general-domain BERT. [ 24 ]
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,WaterBERT是通过DAPT开发的,而不是从零开始预先训练新的模型. 与从零开始的预训相比,DAPT使用无标签域特定文本来调整一个基础语言模型,改善域特定语义表达,同时以更高效的计算方式保留一般语言知识. [ 因此,我们选择了SciBERT作为DAPT的基础模型,因为它的科学预训背景与水处理文献比一般领域BERT更加一致. [24]

blocks.en: Specifically, the vocabulary constructed from our water treatment corpus showed the highest meaningful overlap with SciBERT (57.75%) among the evaluated BERT-based models, compared with 40.99% for BERT-base (Table S2 ). This suggests that SciBERT provides better lexical coverage of water treatment-related scientific text.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,从我们的水处理体中得出的词汇显示,在评估的基于BERT的模型中,与SciBERT(57.75%)的有意义的重叠率最高,而BERT-Base(表S2)为40.99%。 这表明SciBERT为与水处理有关的科学文本提供了更好的词汇覆盖.

blocks.en: DAPT was performed on the constructed corpus using the MLM objective, starting from the SciBERT checkpoint. Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) was not included because the adaptation targeted token-level contextual representations, and prior BERT-family ablations found no consistent benefit from retaining the NSP loss. [ 25 ] In MLM, a portion of the input tokens is randomly masked, and the model is trained to recover the original tokens from their surrounding context (Fig. 1 ). [ 7 ] Whole-word masking was further adopted, whereby all subword tokens belonging to the same word are masked together, ensuring that complete domain-specific terms are treated as unified masking units. The masking probability was set to 0.15. The model was trained with an effective batch size of 160 and a peak learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} using the AdamW optimizer. [ 26 ] Training ran for 940,440 steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, taking approximately 180 h, with the final checkpoint selected based on the lowest validation loss. All remaining hyperparameters are provided in Table S3 . Pseudo-perplexity (PPPL) was subsequently computed on the validation set for water treatment text (see Text S1 for details). [ 27 ]
blocks.zh: DAPT是从SciBERT检查站开始,使用MLM目标对制造的物证进行的。 下一个判决预测(NSP)没有列入,因为适应计划针对的是象征层面的背景表述,而先前的BERT-家庭的积分发现,保留NSP损失没有一贯的好处。 [25] 在MLM中,部分输入符被随机遮蔽,模型被训练从周围上下文中恢复原始符(图1). [7] 进一步采用了全字掩码,将属于同一词的所有子词符号一起蒙码,确保完整的域名特定术语作为统一的遮码单位处理. 蒙面概率设定为0.15. 该型号的培训有效批量尺寸为160,使用亚当W优化器的峰值学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}. [26] 训练在单NVIDIA A100 GPU上跑940,440步,耗时约180小时,最后根据最低的验证损失选择了检查站. 所有剩余超参数均载于表S3。 Pseudo-plexity(PPPL)后来根据水处理文本的验证集计算(详见文本S1). [27]

blocks.en: To further assess whether WaterBERT acquired stronger semantic representations of water treatment terminology through DAPT, a domain-specific CLOZE test was constructed. Two hundred water treatment-related articles published in Water Research after February 2026 were selected, from which words with strong domain relevance, including mechanism, microbial, process, and operation, were masked to form fill-in-the-blank questions. All questions were manually reviewed to remove items without clear water treatment-specific meaning, yielding a final set of 230 CLOZE questions. Performance on the CLOZE test was evaluated using Acc@1, Acc@5, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), measuring whether the correct term was ranked first, within the top five predictions, and the average reciprocal rank of the correct answer, respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估WaterBERT是否通过DAPT获得了较强的水处理术语语义表述,构建了针对域的CLOZE测试. 2026年2月后在Water Research上发表的200篇与水处理相关的文章被选中,从中隐蔽了包括机理,微生物,过程,操作等具有强烈领域相关性的词,形成填充式问题. 对所有问题都进行了人工审查,以删除没有明确水处理特定含义的项目,最终产生了230个CLOZE问题。 CLOZE测试的性能通过Acc@1,Acc@5和Mean recoprocal Rank(MRR)来评价,分别衡量正确的术语是否排在前五个预测之内,以及正确答案的平均对等等级.

blocks.en: 2.4 Downstream task annotation and fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 2.4 下游任务的注释和微调

blocks.en: To further assess whether the semantic advantages gained through DAPT translate into practical improvements in downstream water treatment text tasks, we fine-tuned and systematically evaluated WaterBERT on three labeled tasks: text classification, NER, and RE.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估通过DAPT获得的语义优势是否转化为下游水处理文本任务的实际改进,我们对WaterBERT进行了微调和系统评价,涉及三个标注的任务:文本分类,NER,和RE.

blocks.en: For the text classification task, we designed a multiclass classification task based on article abstracts to evaluate domain-specific semantic understanding. Using the Citation Topics framework from Web of Science, we selected five micro-topics closely related to wastewater treatment processes: activated sludge, adsorption, advanced oxidation, constructed wetland, and nanofiltration.
blocks.zh: 对于文本分类任务,我们根据条款摘要设计了一个多类分类任务,以评估特定域的语义理解. 利用科学网的引用主题框架,我们选择了五个与废水处理过程密切相关的微观主题:活性污泥、吸附、高级氧化、构造湿地和纳米过滤。

blocks.en: NER and RE were used to evaluate WaterBERT’s ability to support structured information extraction from water treatment literature. A total of 1,000 abstracts were manually annotated for both tasks. For NER, eight entity types were defined: pollutant, water treatment process, reactor, treatment parameter, removal efficiency, value, microorganism, and dosed material, yielding 34,902 entities. To capture relationships among these entities, we further defined five RE types: “targets”, “has_efficiency”, “indicates_removal_of”, “conditioned_by”, and “has_value”, covering links among treatment processes, pollutants, removal performance, operating parameters, and corresponding values. A total of 14,471 relations were annotated for RE evaluation. Annotation dataset distributions are summarized in Tables S4 and S5 .
blocks.zh: NER和RE被用来评价WaterBERT从水处理文献中支持结构化信息提取的能力. 为这两项任务共作了1 000份人工说明。 就NER而言,确定了8种实体类型:污染物、水处理工艺、反应堆、处理参数、清除效率、价值、微生物和剂量材料,产生了34,902个实体。 为了反映这些实体之间的关系,我们进一步界定了五个可再生能源类型:“目标”、“效率”、“指标-清除量”、“条件-乘”和“价值”,包括处理过程、污染物、清除性能、操作参数和相应值之间的联系。 共有14 471个关系被附加说明用于可再生能源评价。 注释数据集分布汇总于表S4和S5.

blocks.en: WaterBERT’s performance on downstream tasks was benchmarked against six widely used BERT-based models representing different pretraining backgrounds: BERT-base [ 16 ] and RoBERTa-base [ 25 ] for general-domain text, SciBERT [ 24 ] for scientific literature, and BioBERT [ 28 ] , ClimateBERT [ 29 ] , and EnvironmentalBERT [ 30 ] for domain-specific corpora relevant to water treatment research. All models were trained and evaluated on the same dataset using five-fold cross-validation, with precision, recall, and F1 score reported as evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: WaterBERT在下游任务上的表现以代表不同训练前背景的六种广泛使用的BERT模型为基准:BERT-base [16]和RoBERTA-base [25] 通用域名文本,SciBERT [24] 科学文献,和BioBERT [28],ClimateBERT [29],以及环境BERT [30] 与水处理研究相关的特定领域公司。 所有模型都使用五倍的交叉验证,精确、召回和F1分数作为评价指标,在同一数据集上进行了培训和评价。

blocks.en: 2.5 Large-scale corpus applications of WaterBERT
blocks.zh: 2.5 水生生物圈的大规模生物体应用

blocks.en: To demonstrate WaterBERT’s capacity for large-scale text processing, we applied it to two corpus-level tasks: topic modelling and structured information extraction across the water treatment literature. WaterBERT was applied to topic modelling of 5,144 Environmental Science & Technology (ES&T) articles published between 1995 and 2025 and extracted from the water treatment literature corpus. Article titles and abstracts were used as input. WaterBERT was used to generate document embeddings, followed by Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) dimensionality reduction and Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) clustering within BERTopic. [ 31 ] Candidate parameter settings were screened according to topic granularity, noise proportion, cluster size balance, and interpretability, resulting in a final 35-topic model. The suitability of WaterBERT embeddings was further evaluated against SciBERT under matched BERTopic settings and multiple topic granularities using topic coherence, topic diversity, and clustering noise rate. Detailed procedures for BERTopic model selection and embedding evaluation are provided in Text S2 .
blocks.zh: 为了证明WaterBERT大规模文本处理的能力,我们把它应用于两个实体级的任务:主题建模和整个水处理文献的结构化信息提取. 在1995年至2025年期间发表的5 144篇环境科学与技术(ES&T)文章的专题建模中,应用了水环境科学与技术(WaterBERT),这些文章摘自水处理文献汇编。 条文标题和摘要被用作投入。 WaterBERT用于生成文件嵌入,其次是Unical Manifold Approphination and Projection(UMAP)维度降低和基于噪声(HDBSCAN)群集的应用的等级密度空间集群. [ 31] 根据专题颗粒性,噪声比例,组群大小平衡和可解释性对候选参数设置进行了筛选,最终形成了35个专题模型. 在匹配的BERTopic设置和多个专题颗粒下,对SciBERT嵌入的WaterBERT是否合适进行了进一步评价,采用了专题一致性、专题多样性和集群噪声率。 BERTOPIC模型选择和嵌入评价的详细程序见Text S2.

blocks.en: Using WaterBERT-fine-tuned models, we extracted structured knowledge from the corpus of 693,211 article abstracts to construct a water-domain knowledge graph. The NER model was first applied to all 693,211 abstracts to identify relevant entities. In parallel, a WaterBERT-based binary classifier was used to identify studies specifically related to pollutant removal, retaining 237,110 publications. For the binary-classification criteria, see Text S3 . RE was then performed only on this pollutant-removal subset, using the previously identified entities to extract treatment process–pollutant–removal efficiency records. Only records for which both NER and RE prediction confidence exceeded 0.90 were retained. After model inference, predicted entities were merged to consolidate equivalent mentions across the corpus. Details of the entity-merging procedure are provided in Text S4 . A subset of 300 abstracts was manually evaluated to assess extraction accuracy and benchmark performance against a range of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 利用WaterBERT-fine-turned模型,我们从693,211条摘要中提取了结构化的知识来构建一个水域知识图. NER模型首先适用于所有693,211份摘要,以识别相关实体。 同时,还采用了基于水生生物浓缩技术的二进制分类法,以确定与清除污染物具体有关的研究,保留237,110份出版物。 二进制分类标准见Text S3 。 然后,RE只在这个污染物清除子集上进行,利用先前确定的实体提取处理工艺-污染物-清除效率记录。 只有NER和RE预测信心均超过0.90的记录被保留. 经过模型推论,预测的实体被合并,合并了整个文书中提及的等效实体。 实体合并程序的详细情况见S4文本。 手工评估了300份摘要的子集,以对照一系列有限责任公司评估提取准确性和基准业绩。

blocks.en: Building on the resulting knowledge graph, we developed a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS) to facilitate retrieval and use of the extracted knowledge. A benchmark of 100 retrieval queries focusing on pollutant removal was used to evaluate retrieval performance. Two text-based retrieval methods, BM25-based lexical retrieval [ 32 ] and embedding-based retrieval using BGE (BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5), [ 33 ] were used as baselines for comparison. WaterKERS was constructed by integrating knowledge graph-based retrieval with text-based retrieval. The detailed retrieval workflow of WaterKERS is described in Text S5 and illustrated in Fig. S3 . Retrieval relevance was evaluated using an LLM-as-a-judge framework, in which each retrieved document was classified as fully relevant, partially relevant, or irrelevant to the corresponding query. Retrieval performance was quantified using a relevance score based on these relevance categories. Details of the relevance criteria and evaluation procedure are provided in Text S6 .
blocks.zh: 在由此产生的知识图的基础上,我们开发了一个水知识强化检索系统(WaterKERS),以便于检索和利用所提取的知识。 使用了100次检索查询的基准,重点是污染物的清除,以评价检索的绩效。 两种基于文字的检索方法,BM25基于词典检索[32]和采用BGE(BAAI/bge-group-en-v1.5)嵌入式检索[33]被用作比较基准. WaterKERS是通过将基于知识的图表检索与基于文本的检索相结合而构建的. WaterKERS的详细检索工作流程在Text S5中描述,并在Fig中说明. 第3条。 利用一个LLM-as-a-judge框架评估了检索的相关性,其中将每个检索到的文件归类为完全相关、部分相关或与相应查询无关。 利用基于这些相关类别的相关分数量化了检索业绩。 相关标准和评价程序详见S6文本。

blocks.en: 3 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 3. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 3.1 Domain adaptation improves semantic understanding of water treatment text
blocks.zh: 3.1 域名调整改进了对水处理文本的语义理解

blocks.en: WaterBERT was designed to adapt SciBERT to wastewater treatment literature through continued masked language model (MLM) pretraining on a water treatment corpus. As shown in Fig. S1 , both the training and validation losses decrease consistently throughout pretraining. The training loss drops rapidly at the early stage and then declines more gradually, while the validation loss follows a similar downward trend, decreasing from 1.28 to nearly 1.02 without noticeable rebound, indicating that the model converged stably. After SciBERT was continually pretrained on the wastewater treatment corpus for approximately 1.0 million steps, the resulting WaterBERT achieved a PPPL of 2.33 on the validation set, substantially lower than 2.97 obtained by the original SciBERT. PPPL reflects how difficult it is for a model to predict masked words from their surrounding context. WaterBERT’s lower PPPL means that it can predict missing words in wastewater-domain sentences more easily than SciBERT. These results provide intrinsic evidence that DAPT improved modelling of the language patterns in the water-treatment corpus.
blocks.zh: " 水生生物 " 方案旨在通过继续采用蒙面语言模型(MLM)对水处理装置进行预先培训,使SciBERT适应废水处理文献。 如图S1所示,在整个培训前,培训和鉴定损失都持续减少。 培训损失在早期阶段迅速下降,然后逐步下降,而验证损失则呈类似的下降趋势,从1.28下降到近1.02,没有明显的反弹,这表明模型的趋同性很强。 在SciBERT持续对废水处理装置进行约100万步的预训后,由此产生的WaterBERT在验证装置上实现了2.33PPL,大大低于原SciBERT获得的2.97PPL. PPPL反映了一个模型从周围上下文中预测蒙面字有多困难. WaterBERT较低的PPL表示,它可以比SciBERT更容易预测废水域句子中的缺字. 这些结果提供了内在证据,证明DAPT改进了水处理体中语言模式的建模.

blocks.en: We further evaluated the models using the CLOZE benchmark to examine whether WaterBERT had acquired stronger water treatment-specific semantic representations. In this benchmark, domain-relevant terms were masked in water treatment sentences, and the model was required to recover the missing term from its surrounding context. As shown in Fig. 2 a, WaterBERT consistently outperformed SciBERT across all three CLOZE metrics. Acc@1 increased from 0.224 to 0.343, indicating that WaterBERT more often selected the correct wastewater-specific term as its top prediction. Acc@5 increased from 0.328 to 0.552, and MRR increased from 0.288 to 0.440, showing that WaterBERT also ranked correct terms higher among candidate predictions. These improvements suggest that continual pretraining on wastewater-domain corpora strengthened WaterBERT’s ability to recover domain-relevant terms from treatment-specific contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步利用CLOZE基准来评价这些模型,以审查水生生物伦理学是否获得了较强的水处理特定语义表现。 在这个基准中,与域有关的术语被掩盖在水处理句子中,模型需要从周围上下文中恢复缺失的术语. 如图2a所示,WaterBERT在所有三种CLOZE度量标准中的业绩始终高于SciBERT。 Acc@1从0.224增加到0.343,表明WaterBERT更经常选择正确的废水特定术语作为其最高预测. Acc@5从0.328升至0.552,MRR从0.288升至0.440,表明WaterBERT在候选人预测中也排名正确名词较高. 这些改进表明,对废水领域公司的持续预先培训加强了WaterBERT从具体处理情况中恢复与域有关的术语的能力。

blocks.en: The representative examples in Fig. 2 b offer a more intuitive illustration of WaterBERT’s improved performance. In example 1, “ ammonia is oxidized to [MASK] in the first step of nitrification ,” the masked term refers to the product of ammonia oxidation, for which the correct answer is nitrite. WaterBERT correctly ranks “nitrite” first, indicating that it captures the reaction direction of nitrification and the product role of nitrite. By contrast, SciBERT ranks “ammonia” first, suggesting that it is more strongly influenced by the local co-occurrence between “ammonia” and “nitrification” but fails to infer the correct transformation relationship. [ 34 ] Similarly, in example 2 “ Low dissolved oxygen may lead to nitrite [MASK] during nitrification, ” the expected answer is accumulation, because oxygen limitation can inhibit the subsequent oxidation of nitrite to nitrate, causing nitrite production to exceed nitrite consumption. [ 34 ] WaterBERT assigns a much higher probability to “accumulation” (0.58) than to other candidates, whereas SciBERT ranks the semantically opposite term “reduction” first and also predicts more generic process-related terms such as “formation” and “release”. This contrast indicates that WaterBERT better captures the underlying mechanistic relationships in wastewater treatment processes, rather than simply selecting surface-level terms that appear semantically plausible. Overall, these results demonstrate that domain-adaptive pretraining enables WaterBERT to move beyond general scientific word associations and develop a stronger understanding of wastewater-specific process semantics.
blocks.zh: 图2b中的代表性例子更直观地说明了WaterBERT的业绩有所改善。 在例1中,“氨在硝化的第一步中被氧化为[MASK],”蒙面词指氨氧化的产物,对氨的正确答案是亚硝酸. WaterBERT正确地将“亚硝酸盐”排在首位,表明它抓住了亚硝化的反应方向和亚硝酸盐的产物作用。 相比之下,SciBERT将“ammonia”排在首位,这表明它受到当地“ammonia”和“硝化”之间共同发生的更强烈的影响,但未能推断出正确的转化关系。 [34] 同样,例如, 2 “低溶解氧在硝化过程中可能导致亚硝酸盐[MASK],”预期的答案是蓄积,因为氧限制可以抑制亚硝酸盐随后氧化为硝酸盐,导致亚硝酸盐的生产量超过亚硝酸盐的消耗量。 [34] 水生环保局给“累积”(0.58)的概率远高于给其他候选人的概率,而SciBERT则将“减少”一词排在最前面,并预测“形成”和“释放”等与过程有关的更通用的术语。 这一对比表明,水生生物浓缩技术更好地捕捉废水处理过程中的基本机械关系,而不是简单地选择表面水平的术语,这些术语看起来似乎很合理。 总的来说,这些结果表明,因地制宜的预训使WaterBERT能够超越一般科学词联,并加深对废水特定过程语义的理解。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Model performance on the CLOZE test was evaluated using three metrics (a): Acc@1 (the proportion of questions where the correct term was ranked as the top-1 prediction), Acc@5 (the proportion of questions where the correct term appeared within the top-5 predictions), and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR, the average of the reciprocal ranks of the correct answer across all questions); Representative CLOZE examples (b).
blocks.zh: 图2:CLOZE测试的模型性能使用三个度量标准(a)进行了评价:Acc@1(正确术语排在前1的预测中的问题比例),Acc@5(正确术语排在前5的预测中的问题比例),以及Mean recoprocal Rank(MR,在所有问题中正确答案的对应等级平均值);CLOZE代表例(b).

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmarking downstream water treatment text tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 确定下游水处理文本任务的基准

blocks.en: To assess WaterBERT’s performance in classifying water treatment abstracts, we compared its F1 score with those of the baseline models. As shown in Table S6 , WaterBERT achieved the highest macro F1 score of 90.12 ± 1.97 % 90.12\pm 1.97\% , compared with 88.86 ± 1.77 % 88.86\pm 1.77\% for SciBERT. WaterBERT also achieved the highest F1 score across the five treatment process categories (Table S7 ), demonstrating its improved ability to distinguish semantically related water treatment processes.

Text classification can identify relevant studies, but it cannot provide the structured information required to analyse treatment evidence. We therefore further evaluated WaterBERT on NER and RE. Compared with its base model SciBERT, WaterBERT increased the NER F1 score from 76.13 ± 0.69 % 76.13\pm 0.69\% to 79.50 ± 0.33 % 79.50\pm 0.33\% and the RE F1 score from 70.51 ± 0.64 % 70.51\pm 0.64\% to 74.04 ± 0.56 % 74.04\pm 0.56\% , achieving the best overall performance in both tasks (Table 1 ). WaterBERT substantially outperformed the general-domain BERT-base, with gains of 7.90% for NER and 8.93% for RE, indicating that general language representations are insufficient to capture the entity roles and relations specific to water treatment literature. More importantly, WaterBERT outperformed other domain-adapted models relevant to water treatment research, including BioBERT [ 28 ] , ClimateBERT [ 29 ] , and EnvironmentalBERT [ 30 ] . The gap was particularly evident for EnvironmentalBERT, which only achieved F1 scores of 70.84% for NER and 64.64% for RE. This comparison suggests that an environmentally related pretraining model is insufficient to capture the entity roles and process semantics needed for water treatment information extraction.
blocks.zh: 文本分类可以识别相关的研究,但不能提供分析治疗证据所需的结构化信息. 因此,我们在NER和RE上进一步评价了WaterBERT。 与其基准型号SciBERT相比,WaterBERT将NER F1的得分从76.13±0.69%76.13\pm 0.69%提高到79.50±0.33%79.50\pm 0.33%,RE F1的得分从70.51±0.64%70.51\pm 0.64%提高到74.04±0.56% 74.04\pm 0.56X%,实现了两项任务的总体最佳表现(表1). " 水生生物 " 的绩效大大高于一般领域BERT的基数,NER的增益为7.90%,RE的增益为8.93%,这表明一般语言表述不足以反映水处理文献特有的实体作用和关系。 更重要的是,WaterBERT的效绩超过了与水处理研究有关的其他域适应模型,包括BioBERT[28],ClimateBERT[29],以及EnvironmentBERT[30]. 该差距在环保局尤为明显,该局的F1分数仅为净入学率70.84%,可再生能源64.64%。 这种比较表明,与环境有关的预培训模式不足以反映水处理信息提取所需的实体作用和过程语义。

blocks.en: The category-level results further clarify where these improvements originated (Fig. 3 a,b). WaterBERT showed larger gains over SciBERT for categories that require stronger interpretation of water treatment context. For NER, the improvements were greater for context-dependent entity types, including Dosed Material (+6.3%), Reactor (+6.3%), and Pollutant (+3.6%), than for the more lexically explicit Value entity (+2.0%). WaterBERT distinguished these context-dependent entity types more clearly, resulting in fewer missed entities and fewer cross-type misclassifications (Tables S8 and S9 ). WaterBERT reduced false-negative rates across all entity types and reduced cross-type misclassifications from 356 to 233 (Fig. S2 ). For example, Pollutant entities misclassified as Dosed Material decreased from 59 to 19, while Dosed Material entities misclassified as Pollutant decreased from 22 to 4. For RE, the improvements were likewise concentrated in semantically demanding relation types in water treatment contexts. F1 scores increased by 6.4% for targets, 6.1% for indicates_removal_of, and 5.0% for conditioned_by, compared with only 0.1% for the more explicit has_value relation.
blocks.zh: 类别一级的成果进一步澄清了这些改进的起源(图3a,b)。 在需要更有力地解释水处理背景的类别中,水生生物浓缩技术比SciBERT有更大的收益。 就NER而言,依赖上下文的实体类型,包括剂量材料(+6.3%)、反应堆(+6.3%)和污染物(+3.6%)的改进程度要高于较明确价值实体(+2.0%)。 WaterBERT更明确地区分了这些依赖上下文的实体类型,导致错失的实体较少,跨类型错误分类也较少(表S8和S9)。 WaterBERT降低了所有实体类型中的假阴性率,将跨类型错分类从356个降至233(图S2 ). 例如,被误归类为多塞物质的污染物实体从59个降至19个,而被误归类为污染物的实体从22个降至4个。 就可再生能源而言,改进工作同样集中在水处理方面要求严格的关系类型。 F1的分数在目标上增加了6.4%,在指标上增加了6.1%,在条件值下增加了5.0%,而在更明确的数值关系上只有0.1%。

blocks.en: The examples in Fig. 3 c illustrate why these context-dependent distinctions matter. NaCl is a typical example because its functional role varies across water treatment studies. It may appear as a background dosed material or electrolyte, such as in electrochemical systems, but can also be the target pollutant in studies of saline wastewater or salt removal. [ 8 , 9 ] In the first example, NaCl is a coexisting background substance, but SciBERT incorrectly labels it as a Pollutant, whereas WaterBERT correctly identifies its contextual role. In the second example, SciBERT misclassifies NaCl as a Dosed Material rather than a Pollutant and misses the has_value relation linking current production to approximately 62 mA. It consequently fails to recover the indicates_removal_of relation connecting the treatment process to NaCl and the conditioned_by relation linking the process to its operating conditions. WaterBERT, by contrast, correctly identifies NaCl as a Pollutant and recovers the complete process–pollutant–condition structure. Overall, these results show that WaterBERT’s improved domain-semantic representation translates into more reliable identification of treatment-specific entities and relations for structured information extraction.
blocks.zh: 图3c中的例子说明了这些与上下文有关的区别为何重要。 NaCl是一个典型的例子,因为它的功能作用因水处理研究而异. 它可能作为背景剂量材料或电解质出现,例如在电化学系统中,但也可能是盐碱废水或盐去除的研究中的目标污染物. [8,9] 在第一个例子中,NaCl是一种共存的背景物质,但SciBERT将其错误地标注为一种污染物,而WaterBERT则正确识别了其背景作用. 在第二个例子中,SciBERT错误地将NaCl归类为一种剂量材料而不是一种污染物,并错过了将目前的生产与大约62 mA联系起来的has_value relations. 因此,它无法恢复将治疗过程与NaCl连接起来的表示_迁移关系和将过程与操作条件连接起来的附带条件_关系。 相比之下,WaterBERT正确地将NaCl识别为污染物,并回收了完整的工艺-污染物-条件结构. 总体而言,这些结果表明,WaterBERT改进了域语表达方式,转化为更可靠地确定具体处理实体和关系,以便有条理地提取信息。

blocks.en: 3.3 Topic modeling with WaterBERT–BERTopic
blocks.zh: 3.3 与BERTOPIC合作的专题模型

blocks.en: Topic modelling provides a systematic way to characterize thematic structures in water research. Conventional approaches, such as word frequency distributions and keyword co-occurrence analyses, rely largely on lexical patterns rather than contextual semantics and may therefore miss conceptually related studies expressed using different domain-specific terminology. [ 35 , 36 ] BERTopic addresses this limitation through contextual embeddings, but its performance depends on how well the underlying BERT model represents the target domain. We therefore used WaterBERT, whose improved domain-semantic representation had been validated on water treatment texts, to generate water-domain document embeddings and applied BERTopic to 5,144 water treatment articles published in ES&T . We compared the resulting topic structure with that generated using SciBERT to evaluate whether domain adaptation improves topic coherence and interpretability.
blocks.zh: 专题建模为确定水研究专题结构的特征提供了系统的方法。 常规方法,如文字频率分布和关键词共源性分析,主要依靠词汇模式,而不是上下文语义学,因此可能错过使用不同领域特定术语表达的概念相关研究。 [35,36] BERTopic通过上下文嵌入来解决这一限制,但其性能取决于基础的BERT模型代表目标域的程度. 因此,我们利用WaterBERT(水处理文本上经过改进的域域语表述方法得到了验证)生成嵌入水域文件,并将BERTopic应用于ES&T发表的5,144篇水处理文章。 我们把由此产生的专题结构与利用科学、生物、生物和自然资源研究所产生的结构进行比较,以评估域适应是否改善了专题的一致性和可解释性。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , WaterBERT outperformed SciBERT on all three metrics, with a higher normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) (0.117 vs. 0.077) and topic diversity (84.9% vs. 80.7%), and a lower noise ratio (24.4% vs. 31.0%). The higher NPMI and topic diversity indicate that WaterBERT-based topics exhibited stronger within-topic coherence and greater between-topic distinctiveness, respectively. These differences were also reflected in the top-10 topic representations, which showed clearer thematic separation and less overlap. In contrast, SciBERT showed greater repetition among the top-10 topic representations across different topics; for example, advanced oxidation- and Fenton-related terms repeatedly appeared in Topics 2, 5, and 10, indicating substantial thematic overlap among these topic clusters. WaterBERT also produced more semantically coherent and readily interpretable topic representations. For example, SciBERT’s largest topic combined microbial fuel cells, ammonia-oxidizing bacteria, and activated sludge biofilms, despite these representing conceptually distinct research areas. In contrast, the corresponding WaterBERT topic (Topic 3) was more narrowly focused, with representative terms including ammonia oxidation, ammonium oxidation, nitrification, nitrifying, and nitrite, making it readily interpretable as biological nitrogen removal. Together, these results suggest that domain-adapted representations improve both topic separation and semantic coherence.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,水生生物浓缩技术在所有三个度量标准上都超过了SciBERT, 较高的点定点互通信息(NPMI)(0.117对0.077)和专题多样性(84.9%对80.7%),噪音比(24.4%对31.0%)。 国家预防机制和专题多样性的提高表明,以水、生物、生物、毒素和毒素武器为基础的专题分别表现出更强有力的专题内一致性和更大的专题间特性。 这些差异也反映在前10位专题说明中,表明专题分离更为明确,重叠较少。 与此相反,SciBERT显示,前10位专题在不同专题中出现更多的重复;例如,高级氧化和芬顿相关术语在专题2、5和10中反复出现,表明这些专题组之间的重大专题重叠。 WaterBERT还提出了更加连贯和易于解释的专题说明。 例如,SciBERT最大的课题是结合微生物燃料电池、氨氧化细菌和活性污泥生物膜,尽管这些是概念上截然不同的研究领域。 相比之下,相应的WaterBERT专题(Topic 3)重点更窄,具有代表性的术语包括氨氧化,铵氧化,硝化,硝化,和亚硝酸盐,因此很容易被解释为生物氮去除. 这些结果共同表明,按领域调整的表述既改善了专题分离,也改善了语义一致性。

blocks.en: These improvements in topic separation and semantic coherence suggest that WaterBERT–BERTopic can serve as a practical approach for large-scale topic analysis in water treatment research. Compared with traditional tailored text mining pipelines, it reduces reliance on manually specified categories and lexical rules. For example, Zhu et al. [ 35 ] first defined research categories using domain knowledge and manually selected representative keywords for each category, and then identified research trends by tracking the frequencies of these predefined terms. Thus, the expansion of PFAS-related research was detected because terms such as PFAS, PFOA, and PFAA had been explicitly selected and monitored. In contrast, WaterBERT–BERTopic recovered a distinct PFAS-related theme (Topic 7) without specifying a PFAS category in advance. This is particularly useful for large-scale literature analysis, where manually defining keywords and categories becomes increasingly impractical and may constrain the identification of emerging or previously unrecognized research themes.
blocks.zh: 专题分离和语义一致性方面的这些改进表明,水生生物-BERTOPIC可作为水处理研究中大规模专题分析的实用方法。 与传统定制的文本开采管道相比,它减少了对人工指定的类别和词汇规则的依赖. 譬如诸佛等. [35]首先使用域知识定义研究类别,并人工选择每个类别的代表性关键词,然后通过跟踪这些预定义术语的频率来识别研究趋势. 因此,人们发现与PFAS有关的研究有所扩展,因为PFAS、PFOA和PFAA等术语已经明确选定和监测。 与此相反,WaterBert-BERTOPIC恢复了一个与PFAS有关的不同主题(Topic 7),但没有事先具体说明PFAS的类别. 这对大规模文献分析特别有用,因为手动定义关键词和类别变得越来越不切实际,并可能限制对新出现的或以前未确认的研究主题的识别.

blocks.en: 3.4 WaterBERT enables scalable and cost-effective knowledge construction from water treatment literature
blocks.zh: 3.4 水生生物浓缩技术使水处理文献的知识建设具有可扩展性和成本效益

blocks.en: Evidence in the water treatment literature remains largely embedded in unstructured text. Materials, pollutants, treatment processes, operating parameters and removal outcomes are described using heterogeneous terminology, while the same term may assume different functional roles depending on context. Keyword- and embedding-based retrieval can identify documents with lexical overlap or broad semantic similarity, but cannot reliably organize these elements into connected, retrieval-ready facts. Knowledge graphs address this limitation by organizing entities and their relationships into interconnected, machine-queryable structures, enabling complex factual relationships and constraints to be represented explicitly. [ 37 , 38 ] However, field-scale knowledge graphs for systematically structuring water treatment literature remain lacking. We therefore used our fine-tuned WaterBERT models for NER and RE as the extraction backbone to process 693,211 water treatment abstracts and construct a field-scale knowledge graph. As shown in Fig. 4 a, the graph captures key information entities in water treatment, including materials, microorganisms, parameters, pollutants, treatment processes and reactors. Across the corpus, WaterBERT identified 8,800,205 retained entity mentions, which were consolidated into 118,131 canonical entities and connected by 4,249,707 edges across four relationship types: entity–publication occurrence, BELONGS_TO, SUBCLASS_OF, and REMOVES, providing a structured representation of evidence in the water treatment literature. Further details of entity consolidation and knowledge graph construction are provided in Text S4 .
blocks.zh: 水处理文献中的证据在很大程度上仍然嵌入了无结构文字中. 材料、污染物、处理工艺、操作参数和清除结果使用不同的术语加以描述,而同一术语可能根据具体情况承担不同的功能作用。 基于关键词和嵌入式检索可以识别具有词典重叠或广义语义相似性的文档,但无法可靠地将这些要素组织成连接的,可检索的事实. 知识图通过将实体及其关系组织成互联互通的、机器可调节的结构来解决这一局限性,从而能够明确反映复杂的事实关系和制约因素。 [37,38] 然而,仍然缺乏实地规模的知识图来系统地组织水处理文献。 因此,我们使用NER和RE的微调水生资源模型作为提取干线,处理693 211份水处理摘要,并绘制一个实地规模的知识图。 如图4a所示,该图载有水处理方面的关键信息实体,包括材料、微生物、参数、污染物、处理过程和反应堆。 在整个调查中,WaterBERT确定了8,800,205个保留实体,这些实体被合并为118,131个犬类实体,并由4,249,707个边缘连接在四种关系类型上:实体-出版事件、BELONGS_TO、SUBCLASS_OF和REMOVES,在水处理文献中提供了结构化的证据。 实体合并和知识图构建的进一步详情见Text S4。

blocks.en: To assess knowledge graph extraction reliability and cost, we manually evaluated 300 sampled articles and compared WaterBERT with frontier commercial LLMs and smaller open-weight LLMs. As shown in Fig. 4 b, WaterBERT achieved a graph extraction F1 score of 69.3%, lower than GPT-5.4 (72.2%) and GPT-5.6 Sol (80.4%) but substantially higher than all tested smaller open-weight models (57.6% for Llama-3.3-70B, 53.9% for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 41.7% for Qwen3-8B). It also outperformed GPT-5.1 (68.4%) and GPT-4.1 (68.5%). Error analysis showed that smaller open-weight models more often confused entity boundaries and context-dependent functional roles (Table S10 ). For example, they tended to label standalone concentration units, such as ppb and ppm, as Treatment_Parameter entities or misclassify fixed treatment materials, such as ZIF-67-PAA, as reactors. In contrast, WaterBERT more accurately identified domain-specific spans and functional roles according to their local context. More importantly, WaterBERT approached the extraction accuracy of frontier commercial models at a substantially lower estimated deployment cost. For the full water treatment corpus of 693,211 abstracts, the projected extraction cost of the evaluated GPT models ranged from US$4,402 to US$16,988.52. By comparison, WaterBERT is an encoder-only model with only 110M parameters, and its estimated GPU rental cost for processing the same corpus was only US$29.70 (Fig. 4 c), while still achieving performance close to that of the frontier models such as GPT-4.1. This makes customized, corpus-scale knowledge graph construction feasible for water treatment research groups without extensive commercial computing resources.
blocks.zh: 为了评估知识图提取的可靠性和成本,我们手工评估了300件抽样物品,并将WaterBERT与前沿商业有限责任公司和较小的露天有限责任公司进行比较。 如图4b所示,WaterBERT取得了69.3%的图解F1分数,低于GPT-5.4(72.2%)和GPT-5.6 Sol(80.4%),但大大高于所有测试的小型露天型号(Llama-3.3-70B为57.6%,Qune3-30B-A3B为53.9%,Qune3-8B为41.7%). 它还超过了GPT-5.1(68.4%)和GPT-4.1(68.5%)。 错误分析表明,较小的开放量模型更经常地混淆实体界限和依赖上下文的功能角色(表S10). 例如,它们倾向于将独立的浓度单位,如ppb和ppm,标注为Presentation_. 参数实体或将ZIF-67-PAA等固定处理材料错误分类为反应堆. 相比之下,WaterBERT更准确地根据本地环境确定特定域的跨度和功能作用. 更重要的是,WaterBERT以低得多的估计部署费用处理前沿商业模型的提取精度问题。 关于693,211份全水处理包摘要,经评估的GPT模型的预计提取成本从4,402美元到16,988.52美元不等。 相比而言,WaterBERT是一种只有编码器的模型,其参数只有110M,其处理同一体的GPU租赁成本估计只有29.70美元(图4c),而其性能仍然接近于GPT-4.1等前沿模型. 这使得没有大量商业计算资源的水处理研究小组能够进行量身定制的、体积规模的知识图构建。

blocks.en: Building on this corpus-scale knowledge graph, we developed a graph-based retrieval approach and benchmarked it against text-based retrieval methods. As shown in Fig. 5 a, graph retrieval achieved a relevance score of 71.2, compared with 54.7–64.5 for the three text retrieval baselines: BM25 lexical matching, embedding retrieval, and their hybrid. Graph retrieval returned a higher proportion of fully relevant documents than text-based retrieval (32.9% vs. 16.9–21.1%). This improvement arose from the ability of graph retrieval to map query requirements onto structured facts and enforce explicit constraints on entities and their relationships, thereby retrieving documents that more precisely matched the query. However, for queries or constraints that could not be adequately represented by the graph schema, semantic text retrieval remained useful for identifying relevant documents (detailed analysis in Text S5 ). We therefore integrated graph retrieval with text-based retrieval to construct a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS). This complementary strategy further increased the relevance score to 77.7 and raised the proportions of fully relevant and useful documents to 39.5% and 90.5%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 以这个体积的知识图为基础,我们开发了一个基于图的检索方法,并参照基于文本的检索方法作为基准。 如图5a所示,图书检索取得了71.2的相关分数,而BM25语法比较、嵌入检索及其混合的三种文字检索基线为54.7-64.5。 图表检索返回的完全相关文件比例高于文本检索(32.9%对16.9-21.1%)。 这种改进是因为图检索能够将查询要求映射到结构化的事实上,并对实体及其关系实施明确的限制,从而检索更精确地与查询相符的文件。 然而,对于无法用图表计划充分表达的询问或限制,语义文本检索仍然有助于确定相关文件(在S5文本中的详细分析)。 因此,我们把图表检索与基于文本的检索结合起来,以建立一个水知识强化检索系统。 这一补充战略进一步将相关性分数提高到77.7,并将完全相关和有用的文件比例分别提高到39.5%和90.5%。

blocks.en: The examples in Fig. 5 b illustrate the sources of improvement enabled by graph-based retrieval. In the first example, the query asked for studies in which carbon-based materials were used to remove both pharmaceuticals and personal care products (PPCPs) and heavy metals through co-adsorption. BM25 and BGE retrieved studies on pollutant removal using carbon-based materials, but BM25 failed to satisfy the PPCP constraint, whereas BGE missed the heavy-metal constraint. Graph retrieval instead decomposed the query into typed constraints for the material, the two pollutant categories, and the treatment process, and required all four elements to co-occur. It therefore retrieved documents that satisfied the complete query. Notably, these documents did not explicitly use the umbrella term “PPCPs” but instead referred to specific compounds or subclasses, including antibiotics and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. This terminology mismatch, combined with the requirement for multiple concepts to co-occur, caused text-based methods to rank these factually relevant documents outside the top 1,000 results. A similar pattern was observed in the second example, where the query requested studies reporting nitrogen removal efficiencies below 60%. The text-based methods captured the general topic of nitrogen removal but could not reliably enforce the relationship between the removal metric and the numerical threshold, and therefore returned studies with efficiencies above 60%. In contrast, graph retrieval explicitly linked the “below 60%” constraint to nitrogen removal during nitrification and retrieved studies reporting efficiencies of 31.8 ± 3.5 % 31.8\pm 3.5\% and 34.57 ± 4.54 % 34.57\pm 4.54\% .
blocks.zh: 图5b中的例子说明了以图表为基础的检索所促成的改进来源。 在第一个例子中,查询要求研究使用碳基材料通过共吸收去除药品和个人护理产品以及重金属。 BM25和BGE利用碳基材料检索了关于污染物清除的研究,但BM25未能满足PPCP的制约,而BGE错过了重金属的制约. 图表检索将查询分解成对材料、两种污染物类别和处理过程的打字限制,并要求所有四个要素共同粘合。 因此,它检索到符合完整查询的文件。 值得注意的是,这些文件没有明确使用“PPCPs”这一总括术语,而是提及特定的化合物或亚类,包括抗生素和非类固醇抗炎药物。 这种术语不匹配,加上要求多个概念共同使用,导致基于文本的方法将这些与事实相关的文件排在前1000个结果之外。 在第二个例子中也观察到了类似的模式,其中查询要求进行报告氮去除效率低于60%的研究。 以文字为基础的方法抓住了氮去除的一般话题,但无法可靠地执行去除度量衡和数值阈值之间的关系,因此将效率超过60%的研究退回。 相比之下,图检索将氮化过程中的“低于60%”限制与氮的去除明确联系起来,并检索了31.8 ± 3.5% 31.8\pm 3.5\%和34.57± 4.54% 34.57\pm 4.54\%。

blocks.en: 4 Implications
blocks.zh: 4 影响

blocks.en: Extracting and analyzing information from the water treatment literature has long been essential to research in the field. Whether the goal is to develop data-driven models for contaminant removal, [ 4 , 39 ] synthesize treatment performance across studies through meta-analysis, [ 40 , 41 ] or trace the evolution of research topics, [ 35 , 36 ] researchers have traditionally had to locate, screen, and interpret relevant information scattered across a vast body of publications. The emergence of LLMs offers a new way to automate these tasks, but their use involves a practical trade-off. Frontier proprietary models can interpret complex scientific text effectively but are costly to apply at corpus scale, whereas more affordable open-weight general models may struggle with the specialized terminology, experimental conditions, and treatment processes reported in water treatment studies. [ 6 , 13 , 14 ] This creates a need for a scalable and affordable domain-specific language model for water treatment research.
blocks.zh: 从水处理文献中提取和分析信息长期以来对该领域的研究至关重要。 目标是开发数据驱动的污染物清除模型,[4,39]通过元分析综合各种研究的处理绩效,[40,41]还是追踪研究专题的演变,[35,36]研究人员传统上必须找到、筛选和解释分散在众多出版物中的相关信息。 LLMS的出现为这些任务的自动化提供了一种新的方式,但是它们的使用需要实际的权衡. 前沿专有模型可以有效解释复杂的科学文本,但代价很高,可以按体积适用,而更廉价的开放重量一般模型则可能与水处理研究所报告的专门术语、实验条件和处理过程发生矛盾。 [6、13、14] 这就需要为水处理研究提供一个可扩展和负担得起的特定领域语言模型。

blocks.en: WaterBERT addresses this need by providing a domain-specific semantic foundation that can be adapted to different water treatment literature-mining tasks. Through domain-adaptive pretraining, WaterBERT acquires stronger representations of treatment-specific terminology, contextual roles, and semantic relationships than its general scientific base model. Across downstream benchmarks, WaterBERT achieved the best overall performance among the evaluated BERT models, with F1 scores of 90.12% for multiclass treatment process classification, 79.50% for NER, and 74.04% for RE. These capabilities make WaterBERT applicable across multiple stages of water treatment literature mining. For topic analysis, BERTopic based on WaterBERT embeddings can generate more interpretable water treatment subtopic clusters with less noise, without requiring predefined water treatment terms or categories such as pollutant classes, treatment processes, or manually specified keyword rules. For information extraction, WaterBERT can support a sequential workflow in which a classification model first screens publications according to relevant water treatment topics, followed by customized NER and RE models that extract domain-specific entities and their relationships.
blocks.zh: WaterBERT通过提供适合不同水处理文献开采任务的特定领域语义基础来满足这一需要. 通过域适应性预训,WaterBERT获得了比其一般科学基础模型更强的对处理特定术语,背景角色,语义关系的表述. 在下游的基准中,WaterBERT在经过评价的BERT模型中取得了最佳的整体业绩,F1分数为:多级处理工艺分类90.12%,净入学率79.50%,可再生能源74.04%。 这些能力使水生生物资源应用方案适用于水处理文献开采的多个阶段。 对于专题分析,基于WaterBERT嵌入的BERTOPIC可以生成更多解释性水处理子专题集群,噪音较小,而不需要预先定义的水处理术语或类别,如污染物类别,处理过程,或人工指定的关键词规则. 对于信息提取,WaterBERT可以支持一个顺序工作流程,其中分类模型首先根据相关的水处理专题筛选出版物,然后是定制的NER和RE模型,提取特定域的实体及其关系.

blocks.en: More importantly, WaterBERT’s compact 110M-parameter architecture and low inference cost make it particularly suitable for corpus-scale literature processing. Using WaterBERT-based models, we processed 693,211 abstracts to construct a field-scale knowledge graph containing 118,131 canonical entities and 4,249,707 relationships, at an estimated cost far lower than LLMs (US$29.70 vs. US$4,402–16,989). Building on this corpus-level knowledge graph, we developed WaterKERS and demonstrated how structured domain knowledge can support literature retrieval. As the first open-source corpus-level knowledge-graph retrieval system for water treatment research, WaterKERS provides an accessible platform for the water treatment community to organize and retrieve structured evidence based not only on semantic similarity but also on explicit factual knowledge. The broader value of this framework lies in its extensibility in both the scope of information extracted and its downstream use. WaterBERT can be further adapted to structure topic-specific evidence beyond the pollutant-removal knowledge represented in the current WaterKERS, including areas such as resource recovery, energy consumption, and carbon emissions. Its applications are also not limited to literature retrieval. For example, customized NER and RE models fine-tuned from WaterBERT could extract emission values, reactor configurations, operating conditions, and treatment performance from greenhouse gas studies in water treatment and link them into structured records for meta-analysis, data-driven modelling, and evidence synthesis. [ 42 ] Given the large volume and disciplinary diversity of water treatment research, WaterBERT provides an effective and low-cost foundation for large-scale literature processing and the construction of structured knowledge bases tailored to different subdomains.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,WaterBERT的紧凑的110M参数结构以及低推论成本使得它特别适合对实体级的文献进行处理. 我们利用基于WaterBERT的模型,处理了693 211份摘要,以构建一个实地规模的知识图,其中包含118 131个犬科实体和4 249 707个关系,估计费用远低于LLMs(29.70美元对4 402-16 989美元)。 基于这个实体层面的知识图,我们开发了WaterKERS,并演示了结构化域知识如何能够支持文献检索. 作为水处理研究的第一个开放源码级知识图检索系统,WaterKERS为水处理界组织并检索结构化证据提供了一个无障碍平台,不仅基于语义相似性,而且基于明确的事实知识。 这个框架的更广泛价值在于其可扩展性,包括所提取信息的范围和下游使用。 水生生物和毒素技术可以进一步适应结构上的具体专题证据,超越目前水生生物中体现的污染物清除知识,包括资源回收、能源消耗和碳排放等领域。 它的应用也不限于文献检索. 例如,从WaterBERT中精细调整的定制NER和RE模型可以从水处理中的温室气体研究中提取排放值、反应堆配置、操作条件和处理性能,并将其与元分析、数据驱动模型和证据综合的结构化记录联系起来。 [42] 鉴于水处理研究量大,学科多样,WaterBERT为大规模文献处理和构建适合不同子域的结构化知识库提供了有效和低成本的基础.

blocks.en: This work has several limitations. First, WaterBERT-based extraction relies on explicitly reported information in the literature; as a result, implicit or inconsistently described treatment processes, pollutants, operating conditions, and performance metrics may be missed or incorrectly linked. While high-confidence predictions enhance reliability, the resulting records are intended for corpus-scale organization rather than replacing expert-curated datasets. Second, the current pretraining corpus is dominated by scientific literature and may not fully capture engineering knowledge used in practice. Future research could incorporate sources such as textbooks or design manuals to strengthen representation of process design and operational terminology that is less frequently described in research articles. Third, although WaterKERS incorporates structured knowledge to address the limitations of general text-based retrieval, graph retrieval presents inherent constraints. Complex natural language queries do not always map cleanly onto graph structures, and retrieval is restricted to explicitly defined entities and relations. Therefore, developing embedding models specifically tailored to water treatment is necessary to better organize and retrieve knowledge across the rapidly expanding literature. Future work could focus on improving extraction accuracy, supporting continuous literature updates, and extending WaterBERT to additional water treatment tasks and datasets.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有几个局限性。 首先,基于WaterBERT的提取依赖于文献中明确报告的信息;因此,隐含或不一致描述的处理过程,污染物,操作条件,以及性能衡量标准可能缺失或错联. 虽然高度自信的预测可以提高可靠性,但由此产生的记录是用于实体规模的组织,而不是取代专家精确的数据集。 二,现行预训教材以科学文献为主,可能无法充分掌握实践中使用的工程知识. 未来的研究可以包括教科书或设计手册等来源,以加强在研究文章中描述较少的流程设计和操作术语的代表性。 第三,虽然WaterKERS纳入了结构化知识,以解决基于一般文本的检索的局限性,但图表检索却提出了固有的限制。 复杂的自然语言查询并不总是将干净的映射到图表结构上,检索仅限于明确界定的实体和关系. 因此,必须开发专门针对水处理的嵌入模型,以便更好地组织和检索迅速扩展的文献中的知识。 今后的工作可以侧重于提高提取的准确性,支持不断更新文献,并将水生生物资源推广到更多的水处理任务和数据集。

blocks.en: Text S2. BERTopic model selection and embedding evaluation
blocks.zh: 文本 S2. BERTOPIC 模型选择和嵌入评价

blocks.en: The dataset comprised 5,144 Environmental Science & Technology articles published between 1995 and 2025 and extracted from the water treatment literature corpus. Article titles and available abstracts were concatenated, and WaterBERT embeddings were used as document representations for BERTopic.
blocks.zh: 数据集包括1995年至2025年间发表的5,144篇环境科学和技术文章,并摘自水处理文献汇编。 文章标题和现有摘要作了整理,将WaterBERT嵌入作为BERTopic的文件说明。

blocks.en: For the final taxonomy, 384 combinations of UMAP and HDBSCAN parameters were screened, focusing on solutions containing approximately 25–45 topics. Candidate models were evaluated according to topic number, noise proportion, cluster-size balance, topic representations, and representative documents. The selected model used UMAP with 10 neighbours and 20 components and HDBSCAN with a minimum cluster size of 40, min_samples=1 , and a cluster-selection epsilon of 0.

blocks.en: WaterBERT was compared with SciBERT under controlled BERTopic settings in which only the document embeddings differed. Both models used identical documents, preprocessing, dimensionality-reduction and clustering parameters, topic-reduction procedures, and topic-representation models. The naturally detected HDBSCAN topics were reduced to multiple target topic granularities for comparison.

blocks.en: Text S3. Binary classification criteria for pollutant removal
blocks.zh: 文本编号S3. 污染物清除的二进制分类标准

blocks.en: Abstracts were manually classified based on the information provided in their titles and abstracts. An abstract was labelled as positive only when it clearly described the removal of one or more pollutants by a specific treatment process. Both the treatment process and the target pollutant had to be explicitly identified, while the treatment medium could be either an aqueous phase, such as water or wastewater, or a sludge phase. Studies that focused solely on the occurrence, distribution, transport, transformation, fate, or environmental behaviour of pollutants without explicitly investigating their removal were classified as negative. In addition, pollutant removal had to be clearly stated as an objective or outcome of the study rather than inferred indirectly from the broader context (e.g., studies describing changes in pollutant concentrations during treatment without explicitly indicating that pollutant removal was investigated). Abstracts meeting these criteria were assigned to the positive class, whereas all others were assigned to the negative class.
blocks.zh: 摘要是根据标题和摘要中提供的资料人工分类的。 抽象材料只有在明确描述通过特定处理过程清除一种或多种污染物时才被贴上正面标签。 必须明确确定处理过程和目标污染物,而处理介质可以是水或废水等水相,也可以是污泥相。 仅侧重于污染物的发生、分布、运输、转化、归宿或环境行为而没有明确调查其清除情况的研究被列为负面研究。 此外,必须明确将污染物清除作为研究的目标或结果,而不是从更广泛的背景中间接推断出来(例如,描述处理过程中污染物浓度变化的研究,没有明确说明对污染物清除进行了调查)。 符合这些标准的文摘被划入正类,而所有其他则划入负类。

blocks.en: Text S4. Steps for merging entities in knowledge graph
blocks.zh: 文本编号S4. 在知识图中合并实体的步骤

blocks.en: We consolidated synonymous entity mentions using a type-specific, frequency-aware normalization and clustering workflow. From 8,800,205 mentions extracted from 693,211 publications, we normalized case, whitespace, punctuation and parenthetical abbreviations, retaining normalized forms occurring at least five times. Candidate pairs were generated within each entity type using character 3-gram TF–IDF similarity, abbreviation matching and punctuation-insensitive alphanumeric keys, followed by frequency-ordered leader clustering. Clusters were evaluated using DeepSeek V4 Flash with representative source contexts under conservative instructions that permitted only strict synonym merging while preserving distinctions in hierarchy, chemical state, isotope, isomer, qualifiers and combined processes. The structured model outputs underwent deterministic validation and were subsequently manually reviewed before graph construction. The curated entities were projected back onto the complete corpus to construct a heterogeneous, multilayer knowledge graph comprising three principal node families—canonical entities, publications and hierarchical classification nodes—and relation types: entity–publication occurrence edges weighted by mention frequency, BELONGS_TO edges linking entities to level-2 subclasses, SUBCLASS_OF edges connecting level-2 subclasses to level-3 categories, and REMOVES connecting process to the removal of pollutant, with removal efficiency values attached as edge attributes. The entity layer contained 118,131 canonical entities organized into six domain classes: pollutants, wastewater-treatment processes, reactors, treatment parameters, microorganisms and dosed materials. The distributions of canonical entities and mentions across the major level-2 subclasses of these six domain classes are shown in Fig. S4 .
blocks.zh: 我们合并了同义词实体,提到使用特定类型、注意频率的正常化和集群工作流程。 从8 800 205份中,我们提到从693 211份出版物中摘出的情况,我们把案件、白空间、缩写和括号缩写都固定下来,至少保留了5次正常格式。 在每个实体类型内产生候选配对,使用字符3-gm的TF–IDF相似性,缩写匹配和显式不敏感字母键,然后是频率排序的领袖集群. 采用DeepSeek V4 Flash对集群进行了评价,在保守指令下具有代表性源背景,这些指令只允许严格的同义词合并,同时保留了等级、化学状态、同位素、异构体、修饰剂和结合过程的区别。 结构化的模型产出经过确定性验证,随后在图表构建之前进行了人工审查。 被描述的实体被重新投射到完整体中,以构建一个由三个主要节点(canonical family, 出版物和等级分类节点)组成的多层次的多样化知识图,以及关系类型:实体-出版物的发生边缘以提及频率加权,BELONGS_TO边缘连接实体与二级子类,SUBCLASS_ 连接第2级子类至第3级类别的边缘,以及REMOVES连接进程与去除污染物,去除效率值作为边缘属性附. 实体层包含118,131个犬类实体,分为6个领域:污染物、废水处理工艺、反应堆、处理参数、微生物和剂量材料。 这6个域类中主要2级子类的犬科实体的分布和提及情况见Fig.S4。

blocks.en: Text S5. The retrieval process of Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-03-05). Text S5. 水知识强化检索系统的检索过程。

blocks.en: To prevent retrieval failure when a query cannot be faithfully expressed as graph facts, WaterKERS fuses graph-based retrieval with text-based retrieval. Graph retrieval performs well when the entities, relationships, and constraints specified in a query can be mapped directly onto the knowledge graph, but its effectiveness decreases when the query contains information that is not represented by the graph schema. For example, for the query “Which studies report above 90% removal of oil-in-water emulsion using adsorbent-based treatment?”, the graph correctly mapped “oil” and “adsorption” to relevant entities and relationships and therefore retrieved many studies involving adsorption-based oil removal. However, the graph schema did not encode the directional distinction between oil-in-water and water-in-oil emulsions. Consequently, graph retrieval also returned studies on crude-oil sorption for oil-spill response and water-in-oil emulsion separation. Although these studies shared relevant entities and processes with the query, they did not satisfy its specific requirement for oil-in-water emulsion treatment and were therefore only partially relevant or irrelevant. This example illustrates that structured retrieval can enforce constraints only when the required distinctions are explicitly represented in the graph. In such cases, relying on graph retrieval alone may return incomplete or misaligned results, whereas text-based retrieval can recover relevant documents by matching surface forms and broader semantic context.
blocks.zh: 为了防止在查询不能以图表事实忠实表达时检索失败,WaterKERS将基于图表的检索与基于文本的检索相连接. 当查询中指定的实体,关系和约束可以直接映射到知识图上时,图形检索表现良好,但当查询中包含的不是图表计划所代表的信息时,其有效性会降低. 例如,关于“哪些研究报告说,使用吸附剂处理去除90%以上的水中含油乳液?” ,该图表将“油”和“吸附剂”正确绘制成有关实体和关系,因此检索了许多涉及吸附剂去除石油的研究。 然而,图表计划并没有将水中的石油和油中的油乳之间的方向区分编码。 因此,图表检索还反馈了原油吸附反应油溢反应和石油中水乳液分离的研究。 虽然这些研究与查询分享了相关实体和过程,但它们没有满足其在水中油乳化处理方面的具体要求,因此只是部分相关或无关。 这个例子说明,只有图中明确反映所要求的区别,才可能实施结构性检索。 在这种情况下,仅依靠图检索可能返回不完整或错配的结果,而基于文本的检索可以通过匹配表层形式和更广泛的语义上下文来恢复相关文档.

blocks.en: The fusion pipeline works as follows (Fig. S3 ). A first large language model (LLM1) translates the natural-language query into an executable query plan, decomposing it into atomic entity conditions and grouping them by logical intent: conditions that must co-occur are placed in separate groups joined by AND, while interchangeable alternatives are grouped within an OR. A second LLM (LLM2) then maps each entity condition onto the graph’s classification hierarchy (L3/L2), so that a broad concept such as “carbon-based materials” resolves to its category, “carbon-based adsorbents,” which the graph expands to all papers in that category. Candidate papers are obtained by intersecting the paper sets of all AND-joined groups. Within the graph candidate pool, papers are ranked by BM25, a classic term-weighted text-scoring algorithm, and the top five are retained. In parallel, the query is embedded and matched against a dense vector index (BGE) to retrieve the semantically similar papers by cosine similarity. The final result fuses the two: the graph’s top five form the core, and non-overlapping vector-retrieved papers fill the remaining five slots, yielding a final top-ten ranking that inherits the graph’s precision when facts hold and the vector index’s semantic coverage when they do not.
blocks.zh: 聚变管道工程如下(图S3). 第一个大语言模型(LLM1)将自然语言查询翻译为可执行查询计划,将其分解为原子实体条件,并按逻辑意图加以分组:必须共同使用的条件被置于AND加入的单独组中,而可互换的替代品被分组在一个OR中. 第二种LLM(LLM2)然后将每个实体的条件映射到图的分类等级(L3/L2)上,这样,“碳基材料”等广义概念就解决了它的类别,即“碳基吸附剂”,图中扩展至该类别的所有文件。 候选人的论文是通过将所有 " 合并 " 团体的成套论文相交的方式获得的。 在图表候选集合内,论文按BM25排名,这是经典的名词加权文本评分算法,前五名保留. 同时,该查询被嵌入并和密集的矢量指数(BGE)匹配,以通过同位素相似性来检索成像相似的论文. 最终结果将两者融为一体:图中的前5位构成核心,非重叠的向量检索文件填补了剩余的5个插槽,最终得出了最高十位的排名,从而继承了图中的精确度,当事实存在时继承了向量指数的语义覆盖。

blocks.en: Text S6. Evaluation of retrieval relevance and performance metrics
blocks.zh: 文本编号S6. 评价检索的相关性和业绩计量

blocks.en: We evaluated retrieval quality using a benchmark of 100 queries. Each query was issued to five retrieval systems—WaterKERS (graph–vector fusion), pure graph retrieval, hybrid BM25–BGE retrieval, dense embedding retrieval (BGE), and lexical retrieval (BM25)—with each system returning a ranked list of up to 10 candidate documents from a corpus of 693,211 wastewater-treatment papers. Relevance was judged by a large language model (GPT-5.6-sol), which received each query together with the titles and abstracts of the retrieved documents in a single prompt and assigned each document one of three labels with a one-sentence justification. A document was considered fully relevant if it satisfied all core information and relationships specified in the query; partially relevant if it addressed the core information but omitted or differed in one or more query constraints; and not relevant if it failed to address the core information, mentioned the topic only incidentally, or did not satisfy explicitly specified numerical constraints. For each query, retrieval relevance was quantified using a weighted relevance score (RS): RS = N fully + 0.75 × N partial K × 100 . \operatorname{RS}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{fully}}+0.75\times N_{\mathrm{partial}}}{K}\times 100. where N fully N_{\mathrm{fully}} and N partial N_{\mathrm{partial}} denote the numbers of fully relevant and partially relevant documents, respectively, and K K is the total number of retrieved documents evaluated for the query.
